name: send_telegram
description: Sends a message to the user's phone through their own Telegram bot. Use it when they ask to send something to their phone or to Telegram.
examples: envíame al móvil la lista de la compra
send me a Telegram saying hi

text.description: The message, as it should arrive

say.ok: Te lo he mandado al Telegram.
say.error: Telegram no ha aceptado el mensaje.
